title: Banking & Payment Processor Sync Interface
description: Provide bank account connection interface (Plaid / Open Banking) and CSV bank statement import for transaction sync and automated expense matching.
acceptanceCriteria: Bank accounts view lists connected institutions and balance updates
CSV statement parser handles standard bank formats (OFX/QIF/CSV)
Auto-matches imported transactions with recorded invoices and expenses

steps.details: Create BankAccountsView showing linked checking, savings, and credit card accounts.
Create file upload dropzone that parses CSV columns (Date, Description, Amount) into ledger items.
